details:
I found this when I was editing the face blendshapes animation on the action layer. Here are the steps to reproduce the bug:

1. make an AFK animation in the Action layer, the animation will change the face blendshapes, for example make the avatar close its eyes

2. add a new animation to the FX layer, the content of this animation can not change any blendshape, but can not be None.

3. set this animation in the FX layer to WD on, use avatars 3.0 Emulator Control to enter playback mode, enter AFK mode and the Action layer animation will play normally.

4. Set this animation of FX layer to WD off, use avatars 3.0 Emulator Control to enter playback mode, enter AFK mode, the Action layer animation can not be played normally.

I've seen similar issues with VRC Fury: https://vrcfury.com/technical/wd/#transforms-in-unmasked-controllers-with-wd-off.

But I've noticed that the bug doesn't seem to be related to mask, the problem occurs whether I add mask or not.
title: WD off in FX prevent Action Layer from animating blendshapes
